# Workflow file reference

<!-- Generated by `rhiza docs` from the workflow package. Do not edit. -->

A workflow is a TOML file of named steps. Each step ends with an outcome, and its `on` table names the step to go to next, or `done` or `failed` to end the run. Any key the format does not know is an error.

## File keys

- `name`: The workflow's name; unset takes the file's base name
- `start`: The step the run enters first; unset takes the first step in the file
- `handback_cap`: How many times a run may hand back through an on.<outcome> = "handback:<agent step>" before the next red parks it stopped with an inbox item; a whole number of at least 1, unset takes 3. A hand-back gives every step its full max_visits again
- `autonomous`: true or false: set every autonomy stage to auto or owner at once; not with [autonomy]
- `autonomy`: A table giving a mode, auto or owner, to any of the stages plan, accept, ship and signoff; a stage left out follows rhiza.autonomy.<stage>
- `cleanup`: A [[cleanup]] table, repeated: a command run once when a run of the workflow ends done, failed or abandoned, in the run's worktree with the run's environment, in file order; its keys are run (the shell command, required) and name (lowercase words joined by hyphens; unset takes cleanup-<n>). A failing cleanup step is journalled and logged and never changes the run's result
- `env`: An [env] table of variables, KEY = "value", set for every process the run's steps start: agents, commands and cleanup steps. {run_tmp} in a value is the run's own private temp folder, outside every git repository (under the user cache dir: rhiza/run-tmp/<run id>), made before a step uses it and removed when the run stops, finishes or fails. A name is letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit; RHIZA_* names are Rhiza's own and refused
- `step.<name>` (required): A step, by its name: lowercase words joined by hyphens, at most 30 characters, never done or failed

## Keys every step may set

- `kind` (required): The step kind: agent, command, wait, leaves, checks, signoff, workflow, gate or arbiter
- `on.<outcome>`: The step to go to for an outcome, or done or failed to end the run, or handback:<agent step> to hand the run back to an agent step of the workflow with the cause; the run may hand back handback_cap times, then the next red parks it stopped and an inbox item names the step and the cause
- `max_visits`: How often a run may enter the step; 0 or unset means once
- `stall`: How long the watchdog lets the step go without progress before it acts, such as "20m"; unset takes the watchdog's default for the kind

A kind refuses the keys that are not listed in its section.

## agent step

Runs one agent session with a prompt. It passes when the session says it is done (`rhiza session done`) or exits 0, and fails when it exits otherwise.

Keys:

- `invoke` (required): The text the agent's session starts with, a template over {change}, {slug}, {title}, {run}, {step}, {brief}, {slice}, {handback}, {worktree}, {leaf} and {attempt}; prompt is an alias, and a step sets only one of them
- `handback`: The text a hand-back sends the agent's session, a template over the same placeholders
- `agent`: The agent adapter's name; unset takes the run's, else the default
- `permission_mode`: The agent's permission mode; unset takes the run's
- `models`: Models in order of the attempt, visit or cycle; the last stays for every later one; unset takes the agent's default
- `until`: A shell command: the step also passes when the session is idle and it exits 0, leaving the session open
- `until_when`: With until: idle (check whenever the session sits idle, the default) or done (only once the agent says it is done)
- `interval`: How often the session is checked; 10s, or 30s with until

Outcomes: `pass`, `fail`.

## command step

Runs a shell command. It passes on exit 0 and fails otherwise.

Keys:

- `run` (required): The shell command

Outcomes: `pass`, `fail`.

## wait step

Waits for a condition. It passes when the condition holds and times out otherwise.

Keys:

- `until` (required): A shell command; exit 0 means the condition holds
- `timeout` (required): How long to wait, such as "30m"
- `interval`: How often the condition is checked; unset is 10s
- `max_interval`: With interval: each unchanged check doubles the sleep up to this; a changed output resets it. Unset keeps the interval fixed

Outcomes: `pass`, `timeout`.

## leaves step

Conducts the run change set's leaves: a builder session and then a verifier session for each leaf, retrying a failed leaf. It passes when every leaf passes.

Keys:

- `split`: How the panes lay out: auto (by the tab's shape, the default), right or below
- `interval`: How often the step checks, such as "10s"

Tables:

- `step.<name>.builder` (required): The builder role: prompt, agent, permission_mode, models by attempt
- `step.<name>.verifier` (required): The verifier role, with the same keys plus low_risk_models and risky_paths

Outcomes: `pass`, `fail`.

## checks step

Runs a review's checks, each in a fresh session, all in parallel, then a further cycle of the checks that failed, with a critic judging findings and fixers fixing them. It passes when the checks pass.

Keys:

- `split`: How the panes lay out: auto (by the tab's shape, the default), right or below
- `interval`: How often the step checks, such as "10s"

Tables:

- `step.<name>.check` (required): An array of tables, one per check: name (unique in the step) plus the role keys; at least one
- `step.<name>.critic` (required): The critic role
- `step.<name>.fixer` (required): The fixer role
- `step.<name>.verifier` (required): The verifier role, for a leaf a fixer fixed

Outcomes: `pass`, `fail`.

## signoff step

A review's last step. It runs nothing: it stops the run until the owner signs off. `rhiza run approve` passes it; `rhiza run request-changes` gives the outcome changes.

Keys:

- `on.changes` (required): The checks step that fixes what the owner asked for

Outcomes: `pass`, `changes`.

## workflow step

Runs another workflow's steps inside this run. The file is expanded when parsed: the steps come in named `<workflow>/<step>`. It passes when the inner workflow ends done and fails when it ends failed.

Keys:

- `workflow` (required): The name of the workflow to include
- `skip`: Steps of it to take as passed

Outcomes: `pass`, `fail`.

## gate step

Runs its commands, ones the daemon owns and never an agent, in order in the run's worktree. It passes only when every command exits 0 and fails otherwise; every command runs, and each failing command's full output is kept in a file in the run directory, named in the step's detail.

Keys:

- `commands` (required): The shell commands, run in order; at least one

Outcomes: `pass`, `fail`.

## arbiter step

Not a state of the machine: no step goes to it. In an autonomous run the engine calls it to decide a question an agent step raised, and its outcome goes back to the step that asked. A file declares at most one, only to set its agent, permission mode and interval; its prompt is fixed. Without one a built-in arbiter is used.

Keys:

- `agent`: The agent adapter's name; unset takes the run's, else the default
- `permission_mode`: The agent's permission mode; unset takes the run's
- `interval`: How often the step checks, such as "10s"

Outcomes: `pass`, `fail`.

## Role keys

A role (a builder, verifier, critic or fixer table, or one check) takes:

- `invoke` (required): The text the role's session starts with, a template over the placeholders below; prompt is an alias, and a table sets only one of them
- `handback`: The text a hand-back sends the role's session, a template over the same placeholders
- `agent`: The agent adapter's name; unset takes the run's, else the default
- `permission_mode`: The agent's permission mode; unset takes the run's
- `models`: Models in order of the attempt, visit or cycle; the last stays for every later one; unset takes the agent's default
- `low_risk_models`: Verifier role only: the models by attempt for a low-risk leaf; models stays the ladder for a risky one. Unset means models for every leaf
- `risky_paths`: Verifier role only: path globs (** matches any number of directories; a glob without a slash matches a file name at any depth); a leaf changing a matching file is risky

## Prompt placeholders

A prompt may use only these names in braces, such as `{change}`:

- agent step prompt: {change}, {slug}, {title}, {run}, {step}, {brief}, {slice}, {handback}, {worktree}, {leaf}, {attempt}
- leaves builder and verifier, checks verifier: {change}, {slug}, {title}, {run}, {step}, {brief}, {slice}, {handback}, {worktree}, {leaf}, {attempt}
- checks check and critic: {change}, {slug}, {title}, {run}, {step}, {brief}, {slice}, {handback}, {worktree}, {leaf}, {attempt}, {check}, {cycle}
- checks fixer: {change}, {slug}, {title}, {run}, {step}, {brief}, {slice}, {handback}, {worktree}, {leaf}, {attempt}, {cycle}
